result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber, and statutory workers’ compensation and requires certificates on request. It preserves the existing headings/counterparts provision and is professionally drafted. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring coverage for one year after termination and by triggering cyber coverage based on access to any Confidential Information or hosting the Site, rather than specifically processing Customer Data; those additions make the revision non-minimal.
